messages.content:
Risk: Fraud, scams, manipulation
Description: Using AI systems to gain a personal advantage over others such as through cheating, fraud, scams, blackmail or targeted manipulation of beliefs or behavior. Examples include AI-facilitated plagiarism for research or education, impersonating a trusted or fake individual for illegitimate financial benefit, or creating humiliating or sexual imagery.
Concern: None
Policy: Insurance Fraud & Billing Manipulation

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 5/7 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakePornography: Deepfake Pornography — Creation of synthetic sexually explicit imagery or video using AI face-swapping or body-mapping technology without the depicted person's consent. [found by 4/7 queries]
  Siblings: Voyeuristic Content, Revenge Pornography
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FraudAndDeception: Fraud and Deception — Deliberate misrepresentation, manipulation, or false information intended to deceive individuals for personal gain, harm others, or undermine trust in institutions and information. [found by 3/7 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000146: Artificial Language — A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition. [found by 3/7 queries]
  Siblings: Natural Language
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 3/7 queries]

axes.rationale: The risk involves deliberate misrepresentation and manipulation to deceive individuals for personal gain, which directly relates to the concept of fraud and deception.
Deepfake disinformation is a tool used to manipulate beliefs or behavior, aligning with the risk of targeted manipulation through AI-generated synthetic media.
